item.title: Carrboro: Comprehensive Plan, Black History, Refreshed Website
item.description: Carrboro Mayor Barbara Foushee spoke with 97.9 The Hill's Andrew Stuckey on Friday, February 6, discussing town news and events. She also talked about the council directing town staff to see if there are more support options for unhoused residents.
